name: What is the installation process for replacing an existing sliding door?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for replacing an existing sliding door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with protecting your home's interior and surrounding areas. Our team then carefully removes your existing sliding door and frame. The opening is inspected and prepared, ensuring it's level, plumb, and properly sealed to prevent drafts. The new energy-efficient sliding door unit is then set into place, leveled, and secured. We apply insulation and weatherstripping, then complete interior and exterior trim work. Finally, we test the door's operation, clean up the work area, and demonstrate its features.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves protecting your home, removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing and securing the new door, insulating, trimming, and a final cleanup.
